alert_news.title: India's First Dedicated Green Methanol Bunkering Facility at V.O. Chidambaranar Port, Thoothukudi
bullets: India’s first dedicated green methanol bunkering facility located at V.O. Chidambaranar Port, Thoothukudi, inaugurated by PM Narendra Modi on 11 October 2026.
Storage capacity of 1,500 cubic metres (two 750 m³ tanks) linked by a 2.8‑km stainless steel pipeline; two transfer pumps of 120 m³/h each, enabling 1.2 lakh litres per hour.
Project implemented under the National Green Hydrogen Mission; Ministry of New and Renewable Energy allocated ₹35.34 crore; VOCPA is the implementing agency.
